visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up of a gashapon machine panel featuring the 'Monster Hunter' logo and 'Soundrop' branding. Brightly colored egg-shaped toy keychains in blue, red, gold, and silver are displayed prominently on the sticker. The lighting is bright indoor mall lighting, reflecting off the plastic screen of the machine. (2) A man wearing a black knit beanie and a black hoodie with a colorful graphic print stands in front of a row of yellow gashapon machines. He looks into the camera with a curious expression, holding a coin ready to be inserted. The background is filled with rows of similar vending machines in a retail environment. (3) The camera focuses on his hands as he inserts coins into the slot and turns the green plastic handle clockwise several times. We see the mechanical parts inside moving as the capsule is dispensed. (4) A golden-brown plastic capsule drops into the retrieval slot at the bottom. The man reaches in, picks it up, and brings it closer to his face to examine it. (5) He unboxes the capsule to reveal a brown egg-shaped toy featuring an illustration of a cat character. He points back at the display machine, specifically targeting a white egg icon, indicating he wanted that one instead. (6) He presses a button on the cat-themed toy, and the camera moves in for an extreme close-up of the toy's back, showing a circular speaker grille. (7) Later, he is shown opening a yellow capsule containing a yellow egg-shaped toy with a 'well-cooked meat' icon. He looks satisfied and holds it up proudly for the viewer to see against the store background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice hums a heroic, orchestral melody from 'Monster Hunter' with high pitch variability and a confident tone. There is no background music, but faint room resonance is audible. (2) Sound of coins being dropped into a metal slot followed by the rhythmic 'click-clack' of a mechanical gashapon handle turning. The man speaks in a casual, enthusiastic manner. (3) Crisp plastic rustling sounds as a capsule is opened. The man expresses a mix of surprise and mild disappointment. (4) A bright, digital 'meow' sound effect plays several times, which is a toy-generated SFX with high spectral brightness. The man narrates his reaction over these sounds. (5) A short, upbeat synthesizer jingle plays—the 'BBQ' theme from the game—at a moderate tempo. This is immediately followed by a high-pitched female vocal clip saying 'Jouzu ni yakemashita!'. (6) The BBQ music and vocal clip repeat multiple times with consistent loudness. The man's voice overlaps these sounds, sounding satisfied and humored by the successful toy draw.
